Title: Embedded Software Engineer
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or Computer Engineering
- At least 2 years of embedded software development experience
- Must have strong programming skills in C, C++, Linux, and Git
- Hands-on experience with device drivers and low-level hardware debugging
Nice to have:
- Experience with RTOS, ARM architecture, and hardware communication protocols is a plus
- Python scripting knowledge is desirable
